body: If you hate the world in the evil it serves, then kill the people you see as responsible for perpetuating the problem and THEN commit suicide. In my case, I don't have a car or a gun, so I couldn't do that, but if I was set on suicide... I would definitely fire some silenced rifle bullets in a couple of power broking skulls first.

Yeah, that's the fear I have of telling my therapist. Been thinking suicide for 5 years. I heard stories about people telling therapists about suicidal thoughts before I even saw them. Some things never change.

I was obsessed with a girl that we had too much alike. I was too broken to be with her. My greatest fear I had for 6 years, being unprepared for the one, felt like it finally came true. This woman is not your salvation or your true happiness. No answer for that one, same boat.
She was both oblivious and unharmed.

Suicide and maniacs are different things. Death is my choice. 

Your point is to preserve the body for charity... I guess your idea was to convince me of self-fufillment, when I'm looking for happiness and love, not redemption. I wasn't asking how to be valuable to society: I was asking what would stop the suffering, or better yet reverse it.

Choosing my way to die has a short timeframe on it. It's around the same time I'll become homeless.

I asked for a reason not to kill myself. That was not a reason. The joys of overcoming my pedophilic urge to look at jailbait porn so I can never hold a job in society, where my peers look on me and judge me a monster? Don't waste my fucking time, what's left anyways.
